principle: One OpenSAAB interface and workflow on every supported platform. A port is incomplete until its installed interface passes the same scenarios.

program_identity.historical_packages: Preserve prior signed packages and evidence; do not rename an app during an active diagnostic session.

android_distribution_nomenclature.date_and_identity: Full packaged version and architecture in installed/program/window identities; version date on every fresh-launch Developer Preview screen

visual_design.wide_header: Tech 2 / Diagnostic workspace with Expand screen; Show header while expanded

visual_design.states: Keep live, offline, saved history, stopped and unavailable meanings from the existing shared workflow.
visual_design.accessibility: 48dp controls; visible keyboard focus, hover and pressed feedback; disabled controls stay visibly disabled.
visual_design.adoption: macOS ARM64 preview implemented; other targets tracked pending in baseline status.
visual_design.style: Charcoal background and raised neutral session panel; blue primary action; monospaced firmware keys; quiet utility controls; software group divider and details affordance.

labels.session_mode_help: Full session allows supported changes. Original confirmations and security access still apply.

semantics: EXIT navigates back inside firmware and never stops the app.
Stop emulation belongs to the app menu.
Offline, detected adapter, opening adapter, verified live ECU and stale saved data are distinct states.
Unavailable actions explain the missing capability; a visible button is not implementation proof.
One language preference coordinates app strings and the selected diagnostic image, with explicit fallback.
Cancel and unplug release the transport; stale VIN or incomplete DTC responses never appear as fresh success.
CANdi starts only when the first guest command needs it.

Firmware selection stays reachable during emulation. Changing software offers to stop and release the adapter first; cancelling keeps the current session and selection. Selecting software never silently reconnects the vehicle.

Security seed collection is a distinct connection mode. It reads challenges through original diagnostic menus; it never implies completed security processing or ECU authorization. A locally blocked request must be distinguished from an ECU rejection or application crash.

Adapter session mode is an explicit foreground choice. Read-only defaults only where enforced; Read + write binds existing full native authority. Separate security collection retains its own authority. Transport ownership never silently changes command policy. A stopped session clears live claims and offers a fresh connection.
allowed_platform_differences: OS installer, permission and file-picker dialogs
Window chrome, system font rendering, and keyboard/mouse equivalents of touch gestures
Responsive layout following available window size, never app ABI

scenarios.setup: Fresh install to ready screen; same product steps and selected language; show any OS permission dialogs.
scenarios.ready: Header, status, Connect and start, offline entry and firmware selection use the reference labels and hierarchy.
scenarios.offline: Start offline, reach real Main Menu, then Diagnostics/model year, move selection and return with EXIT. No live vehicle claim.
scenarios.controls: Show S1–S4, full keypad, Actions, Console and app menu; demonstrate EXIT versus Stop emulation.
scenarios.responsive: Capture compact and wide layouts, expanded screen and restored header; preserve 4:3 framebuffer and accessible keys.
scenarios.language: Switch English to a supported non-English diagnostic image and back; show app-language fallback, progress, cancellation and retained working selection.
scenarios.connected: Using the same supported bench fixture, detect/name Chipsoft and read a fresh VIN and complete T8 HS-CAN DTC report through the installed interface.
scenarios.recovery: Cancel work, disconnect/reconnect adapter, then stop and reopen; no stale success or held adapter handle.
scenarios.advanced_actions: Compare every reference Actions/app-menu entry and its behavior; record unsupported functionality as a gap, never a parity pass.
scenarios.branding: Official logo and always-visible Donate · Support OpenSAAB footer in compact, wide and expanded views; donation dialog requires explicit Continue and never interrupts an active session. No diagnostic data in URL. About / Support also offers an explicit Discord community action using the permanent invite; no automatic navigation, appended vehicle data or interruption of an active session.
scenarios.security_status: Display cleared, PRE-AUTH, POST-AUTH/Fresh, POST-AUTH/Stale, invalid and unavailable states using isolated synthetic data. Verify the three-hour boundary, changed card/vehicle, missing receipt, future timestamp and reopen without rejuvenating old data. Show details in expanded mode. Separately qualify real processing/import; no simulated ECU authorization claim. Collect seed data, verify PRE-AUTH refresh, stop/reopen and retain the state for the same firmware/vehicle; verify another vehicle or firmware cannot inherit it.
scenarios.session_modes: Select Chipsoft full native control and complete the original Check Ignition Key Status test. In restricted mode verify the same command is blocked before USB, the ended session is clearly displayed, and reconnect works. Keep seed-only and offline modes isolated from inherited environment flags. Qualify separately on each installed target.
scenarios.security_processing: Collect on the installed app, follow physical key prompts, consent, process, validate/import and resume. Separately test denial, outage with/without fallback consent, TLS/redirect/oversize/malformed response, cancel, changed context and reopen without rejuvenating the receipt. Hardware authorization requires observed ECU evidence. Reopen with valid PRE-AUTH at the splash screen or offline: offer Process existing data without another VIN read. POST-AUTH offers Continue firmware. Mismatched/partial/changed data must not be substituted from history. Process after a clean operator Stop, preserve idle handoff eligibility, reject obsolete refreshes after return/import, and offer Continue firmware from the matching imported card while retaining PRE evidence. Unconfirmed cleanup, explicit cancellation, changed USB target and background state cannot silently restart diagnostics.
scenarios.saved_dtc_reports: Passively capture original numbered DTC Information screens; mark partial coverage, deduplicate by module/code/suffix, retain raw observations and full detail text; reopen after restart, review/export/share without sending diagnostic commands. Do not claim a complete vehicle scan or inherit another session VIN.
scenarios.report_restoration: Prepare synthetic report, confirm review, rotate, dismiss/reopen, lose background process, restore exact ID/JSON/hash, reset process-loss consent, restore matching sent receipt with disabled Send, then prepare new incident. No routine production upload.
scenarios.session_end: Exercise all session_end causes, reject late frames, preserve evidence and accurate reason; EXIT does not Stop. Connected transport release independently requires hardware.
scenarios.gesture_scrolling: Verify both swipe directions with Natural scrolling off and on against original menus. Persist the choice across cold relaunch. Keyboard/keypad directions, hold-to-ENTER, plain taps and app scrolling remain unchanged; changing the preference does not stop emulation or send a firmware key.
scenarios.security_collection_paths: From existing POST-AUTH, choose each fresh collection path. Manual emits no automatic menu keys; guided selects the observed security menu and leaves all physical prompts to the owner. Confirm mode survives restart, old receipt cannot override collection, exactly SSA is erased only on a disposable copy, previous source/receipt survives cancel/failure, completed fresh data can process against the preserved source, and Get security access is reachable without nested menus. Qualify original seed requests and completion on the exact installed adapter/build. Publish session before VIN metadata; then provide verified same-run context and require navigation to begin. Manual takeover before metadata arrival must prevent later automatic keys.
scenarios.nano_reboot: Verify Nano-only action visibility, explicit choice among multiple Nano adapters, public/nondebug mode without firmware, active-session stop/clean release, cancelled/timeout/changed-target failure, exact reboot acknowledgement, zero vehicle writes, USB closure and preserved security data. Owner reconnects for a separate fresh VIN; no automatic diagnostic replay.
scenarios.developer_preview_welcome: Cold launch shows Developer Preview, packaged full version/architecture and release/issue date before workspace/setup/diagnostics. Report issue opens existing report form without preparation/upload; return preserves notice. Continue reaches app; rotation/return does not repeat it. New cold launch shows it again. Verify compact/wide/large-text readability and offline metadata.

support.title: Help keep OpenSAAB moving
support.message:
I’ve put my own time into bringing OpenSAAB to life. If it helps you, consider buying me a beer or supporting development. Contributions help fund adapter testing, documentation and ongoing work.

Support is voluntary. It does not unlock features, purchase vehicle security access or guarantee compatibility. Testing, documentation and code contributions are welcome too.
support.external: Continue opens the project’s donation page in your browser. No vehicle data or diagnostic logs are added to the link.
support.pending: The donation page is not available yet. Thank you for supporting the project through testing and feedback.
support.no_browser: No browser is available to open the project page.
support.wait: Finish the current session before opening project support.
support.placement: Fixed footer outside scrolling or collapsible headers; visible during setup, ready, connected, offline and expanded app views. OS dialogs may cover the app.
support.community_message: Join openSAAB on Discord for releases, help, testing feedback and development. Opens Discord in your browser; no vehicle data or diagnostic logs are added to the invite.

security_status.source: 714-byte SSA at card offset 0xFE0000. Prefer the active session guest SSA checkpoint over its startup card; after exit use the last matching session. Validated legacy guest snapshots may recover collected data. Never assume the immutable download is current. A validated imported result for this exact collection supersedes its preserved PRE snapshot only when full VIN and selected SSA hash match. An explicitly requested fresh collection retains priority over historical imports. Distinct MDI UUID/native directories never match by basename alone.
security_status.receipt: Android schema-1 security-processing-status.properties; bind vehicle_hash to VIN and ssa_hash to current SSA. Only imported data with valid timestamps has known age.
semantics: INIT_AUTH means cleared; PRE-AUTH means collected; POST-AUTH means processed data present. None confirms current ECU authorization.
Stale is advisory imported-data age >= 3 hours. Do not clear, reset or block a diagnostic operation based on this label.
Missing or invalid receipt, changed card, another vehicle or future import timestamp cannot produce Fresh.
Never replace imported_utc or last observed connection time with app startup, download time or file modification time.
Read-only status and details remain available through Actions while the header is hidden. Refresh while idle and running.
Unsupported processing remains explicitly unavailable; status display does not close that capability gap.

Collecting security data updates the displayed working state. Reopening a session preserves collected SSA only for matching firmware and vehicle, without altering the immutable download, old evidence or receipt timestamps. Status rendering is read-only; lifecycle restoration is separate.

upcoming_presentation.owner_requirement: Replace the headline Fresh/Stale presentation with last security-access timestamp and VIN last four beside Auth_Status.
upcoming_presentation.timestamp_example: Last SA data import: <saved date, time and timezone>
upcoming_presentation.timestamp_source: Successful validated security-data import: matching receipt imported_utc. Do not label API start, response-only, seed collection or app startup as successful SA. This timestamp describes imported data, not a current ECU grant.
upcoming_presentation.binding: Validate the complete VIN/vehicle_hash and current SSA/ssa_hash before presenting an import as belonging to this Auth_Status. Display only the VIN last four in this summary; never use last-four equality to associate receipts.
upcoming_presentation.missing_context: Last SA data import: not recorded; no borrowed timestamp from another VIN/card, file modification, app startup or a failed processing attempt. Missing/future/invalid timestamps remain unknown.
upcoming_presentation.history: Previous SA imports for changed security data may appear in clearly labelled history, separately from the current Auth_Status; never imply that old history authorizes the current session.
upcoming_presentation.semantics: Preserve INIT_AUTH/PRE-AUTH/POST-AUTH/INVALID/N/A state meanings. Replace headline Fresh/Stale wording with saved timestamp/context, with elapsed age available in details. No automatic expiry, recollection, reset or command block based on age.
verification_plan: Successful matched import shows saved import date/time/timezone and associated VIN suffix.
Stop, app reopen and adapter reboot do not refresh imported_utc.
Different full VIN with the same last four cannot inherit the timestamp/status.
Changed SSA, partial response, failed processing, missing receipt or invalid/future date cannot inherit a successful current import timestamp.
Main/compact headers, expanded details and all declared targets use the same presentation.

password_policy.scope: All future OpenSAAB releases and platforms provide implemented security processing/import without an operator password or feature entitlement. Applies to UI, automation and fallback. Unavailable features stay unavailable.
password_policy.verification: No separate operator-password acceptance/rejection proof is required in any channel. Retain ordinary exact-artifact consent, cancellation, response validation and SSA import checks; a local successful import does not establish ECU authorization.
password_policy.adoption: Owner policy and release tooling updated for every target. Windows 0.2.18-preview.5 already passed exact installed no-dialog checks under its historical preview_no_prompt metadata. Other bindings and future qualified artifacts require separately recorded adoption and installed observations; no runtime pass inferred.

developer_preview.selection: Historical preview_no_prompt metadata remains supported for retained preview packages; new bindings use the common no_operator_password mode in all channels.

legacy_credential.scope: Public fixed primary-service compatibility value only. It does not authenticate or authorize callers and provides no endpoint abuse protection; server-side controls are separate.

rules: Processing accepts validated existing PRE-AUTH from the selected session, including offline/reopened sessions, when exact matching completed-collection evidence and unchanged firmware/vehicle are available. Offer Process existing data and Collect fresh data separately. POST-AUTH offers continuation, never forced recollection. Revalidate selected data after stop and before import; never automate physical ignition-key acknowledgements.

Explicit consent precedes disclosure of VIN and 714-byte security data. Primary first; one separately consented outage-only fallback. Password goes only to the primary service. No redirects, TLS bypass or malformed-response fallback.

Stop the emulator and release the adapter before processing. Validate the complete reply against the original seed records, back up the card, patch only the 714-byte SSA and verify surrounding bytes before atomic activation.
Cancellation or changed session/vehicle/card leaves the previously active card intact. Credentials remain in the native protected credential store when the user chooses to remember them.

Imported card data displays POST-AUTH with a bound, persistent receipt. It does not claim current vehicle authorization. Resume requires the same adapter connection; firmware retains responsibility for vehicle security exchanges.

Before deliberately stopping for security processing, notify the crash monitor that this is an expected stop. Preserve the bounded cleanup timeout and processing error path; unrelated unexpected exits must remain reportable.

Get security access is reachable from Ready and Actions. Collect fresh data explicitly offers Manual collection (owner navigates Diagnostics → All → Get Security Access) and Guided collection (recognized original firmware menus only). Missing/unknown mode defaults to manual; a firmware control cancels guidance. Original firmware owns seed requests; never synthesize a host seed client or acknowledge physical ignition prompts.

An explicit fresh request takes precedence over an older imported receipt. Start collection from a disposable card with exactly the 714-byte SSA erased; preserve the selected source card, old receipt and every surrounding firmware byte. Retain source-before and guest-before evidence separately: fresh guest proof is checked against guest-before, while import checks the unchanged selected source baseline. Collection needs no internet or password; processing requires separate authorization and disclosure consent.
security_workflow.platform_status: Shared worker and macOS binding under qualification; Windows/Linux bindings and Android shared-core cutover pending.

collection_paths_candidate.scope: Urgent Android oracle fix; shared Rust migration and all installed physical tests pending
collection_paths_candidate.guided_scope: Recognized English menus; operator confirms Saab 9-3 Sport (9440), MY2003–2012. Fresh VIN supplies the year without an external lookup. Unknown model/year/language falls back to manual.
collection_paths_candidate.context_arrival_rule: A new session directory can precede fresh verified VIN metadata. Wait without constructing a cancelled navigator, then start assistance when matching same-run context arrives. Never substitute previous identity or override an operator manual takeover.

operator_password_menu_retired.reason: No operator password or feature credential on any channel. Do not restore a password menu as a parity gap.

dtc_reports.worker: opensaab-reports schema 1; passive observation, durable list/read
semantics: Maximum 8192 bytes per screen and 200 list positions. Require two stable reads.
List coverage is not module coverage; empty or unrecognized screens never mean no faults.
Group overlapping observations by module/code/suffix; retain raw screens, real duplicates and full descriptions.
New session or changed list total starts a new report; leaving a list ends its aggregation.
Only session-local VIN evidence is included. Offline sessions cannot inherit global VIN.
Review and explicit export/share preserve the active diagnostic session. No automatic upload.

rules: Explicit Trionic 8 HS-CAN scope; fresh VIN before code collection. No clears, security access or programming.
A complete report requires the A9/81 terminator, session-stop acknowledgement and successful channel/device release; silence is never an empty-code success.
Preserve every code, failure-type byte and status byte; label Current/History without discarding other status bits. Save locally and expose Saved DTC reports.
Continue to diagnostic menus is offered only after successful cleanup. A new VIN check precedes handover after report review.
Bench and car fixtures can share a VIN; identify physical fixtures independently in qualification evidence.
engine_startup.platform_status: Android reader ported into desktop Rust; macOS binding under bench qualification. Windows standalone comparison only; Windows GUI integration and Linux pending.

support_reporting_candidate.follow_up_contact: Optional email or forum handle, excluded unless explicit unchecked-by-default consent is selected; included in privately reviewed description only.
support_reporting_candidate.diagnostics: Bounded fixed failure categories, session association, lifecycle and security-handoff events; no raw traffic or security payloads.

native_panic_location.source: Last recognized Rust panic header in the bounded log tail; accept older headers and current numeric-thread-ID headers. Export at most three relative source-path components, integer source position and bounded thread name. Exclude panic message, raw output, build prefix and numeric thread ID.
native_panic_location.retention: Offline and Nano process readers retain panic headers after the 2 MiB routine-output cap; routine output remains capped and the report tail remains bounded.
native_panic_location.submission: Existing frozen review, consent and explicit send; deploy additive strict server validation before distributing a collector that emits the field.
native_panic_location.adoption: Android ARM64 preview.92 installed emulator and real synthetic Rust panic passed. ARM32, desktop and iOS collection adoption and exact-artifact qualification remain pending; server intake remains cross-platform compatible.

support_reporting_candidate.publication: Public analysis must exclude contacts, receipt IDs, raw descriptions, VINs and security data.

security_snapshot.source: Saved working card plus matching vehicle and processing receipt; same semantics as vehicle history, not a live ECU probe
security_snapshot.privacy: No VIN, card bytes, seeds, keys or receipt hashes
security_snapshot.limits: Unknown stays unknown. POST-AUTH and Fresh do not establish ECU authorization.

support_reporting_candidate.review_actions: Keep Prepare report, explicit upload consent and Send to OpenSAAB reachable independently of the full JSON preview and keyboard. Show why sending is disabled. Never upload automatically.

offline_evidence.meaning: Incomplete exit is not proof of crash; absence of adapter is normal offline context, not a cause.
required_when_available: CANdi fixed reason and numerical progress
first two and last ten resource samples and sampled extrema
offline_evidence.privacy: No raw reason, screen, key values, transport payload, register value or firmware bytes. Unsupported access address, width and direction are numerical emulator diagnostics.
offline_evidence.missing_evidence: Explicitly unavailable or unknown; never infer normal completion or lack of crash.
offline_evidence.submission: Same frozen review, separate consent and explicit send; no automatic upload.

chipsoft_firmware_identity.source: Existing successful GET_INFO response; no additional vehicle commands
chipsoft_firmware_identity.states: Not detected until a valid reply; last detected after stopping; clear on new discovery
chipsoft_firmware_identity.compatibility: Detection does not imply native backend support
chipsoft_firmware_identity.reports: Validated version token only; no raw identity or serial

update_discovery.installed_identity: Visible app version and executable architecture; Android OS/model in About and details
update_discovery.automatic: Optional, enabled by default; public HTTPS catalog at most once per 24h while foreground and idle, bounded request; no vehicle/device identifiers
update_discovery.selection: Exact package/ABI channel, strictly validated version code and official release URLs; ARM32 and ARM64 independent
update_discovery.presentation: Nonmodal idle banner only for newer release; View update, Remind me tomorrow (24h), manual Check for updates with opt-out
update_discovery.safety: No diagnostic interruption, silent APK download, install, uninstall or forced update. Hide on background/session start. Offline failure quiet; cached offer expires after 7 days.
update_discovery.legacy: Old APKs need one manual update before automatic reminders exist.

menus.rule: Entries remain visible when a platform lacks a capability; show its specific reason. Visibility is not implementation or qualification. Android remains the behavior reference; no offline session invents a VIN or live diagnostic result.

report_review.consent_label: I reviewed this report and agree to private upload
report_review.body_identity: Saved artifact ID and SHA-256 of the exact uploaded UTF-8 JSON bytes; ZIP is an export envelope only.
report_review.restoration: Restore the exact reviewed artifact. Changed/missing files are an explicit error; never regenerate or substitute the newest report.
report_review.consent_lifetime: Affirmative consent may survive configuration rotation only while the same open artifact ID/hash remains in a host-scoped ViewModel. Reset after dismissal, new preparation and process loss. Never persist affirmative consent.
report_review.confirmed_delivery: On a newly confirmed upload with a durable artifact-bound receipt, dismiss review and return to the prior screen. Retain the receipt locally. Reopening a sent report displays Already sent and hides/disables Send and consent. If delivery cannot be confirmed or persisted, retain the review and explain the retry or receipt-preservation action. Legacy unbound receipts remain unknown.
report_review.uncertain_delivery: Retain exact bytes and require explicit retry; local receipt binding does not establish server deduplication.
report_review.active_reporting: Target: report dialog over the existing session host, deliberately gate guest input and collect a bounded session snapshot without report-induced pause/resume. Android first pass retains the active-report guard until the shared collector schema is qualified.
report_review.collector: Shared Rust collector/artifact/receipt/description engine is the migration target. Java retained only for the bounded first Android pass with immutable JSON restoration.

session_end.presentation: Clear live framebuffer and current connection claim on every end, retain evidence, invalidate late display callbacks and preserve the known end reason. Unknown remains unknown.
session_end.input: EXIT remains original-firmware navigation; Stopping rejects additional guest input.
session_end.hardware_limit: Display clearing does not establish transport release; port/ownership checks require hardware.

diagnostic_prerequisites.offline_message: This action needs a supported adapter and a freshly identified vehicle. Offline menus do not provide a vehicle connection.

gesture_scrolling.label: Natural scrolling
gesture_scrolling.natural_description: Swipe up moves the selection down; swipe down moves it up.
gesture_scrolling.directional_description: Swipe up moves the selection up; swipe down moves it down.
gesture_scrolling.scope: Vertical swipes on the original firmware display only. Keyboard arrows, keypad buttons, hold-to-ENTER, taps and app scrolling retain their meanings.
gesture_scrolling.persistence: Saved per device, applied immediately, retained across app relaunch and updates. Default off preserves the existing Android directional behavior.

vlinker_bench_test.title: vLinker MC+ bench test
vlinker_bench_test.scope: Explicit host bench operation, separate from original firmware emulation. Identify opens no CAN protocol; VIN sends one 1A 90 request on 7E0/7E8, 500 kbit/s P-bus.
vlinker_bench_test.failure_rule: Cancel, timeout or disconnect clears pending VIN and releases the transport. No automatic vehicle request replay. Publish success only after VTPC and transport release.
vlinker_bench_test.simulator_rule: Debug Xcode simulator uses an explicitly selected local Mac Bluetooth relay with an observed BLE or Classic SPP profile. Offline original-menu sessions never inherit its VIN. This does not qualify direct physical-iPhone Bluetooth or full firmware diagnostics.
vlinker_bench_test.probe_rule: Explicit ECM-only probe with fresh VIN; readIdentifier 1A fields retain raw bytes and documented names. A9/81 current/history mask 12 requires a real 5E8 end marker plus confirmed 10/20 session stop, VTPC and Bluetooth release. No clear/programming/security writes or automatic replay.

adapter_startup.reference: ChipsoftUsbActivity, VehicleSession and VehicleIdentity: fresh VIN -> confirmed discovery release -> bounded vehicle lookup -> durable session identity -> adapter firmware handoff.
adapter_startup.history_rule: Last vehicle is saved history only. Starting offline, cancellation, reconnect or backgrounding cannot inherit a current vehicle claim.
adapter_startup.firmware_gate: Vehicle identification and running original firmware through an adapter are separate states. A missing firmware transport returns an explicit unavailable result; never start offline emulation as a connected substitute.
adapter_startup.ready: Choose Connect and start to identify the vehicle, or Run without an adapter to explore the menus.

android_bluetooth.selection: Select adapter → Carista EVO / vLinker MC+ · Bluetooth → Select Bluetooth adapter. Refresh paired adapters or explicitly Find nearby adapters; connect only after Use selected adapter.
android_bluetooth.permissions: API31+: Nearby devices CONNECT/SCAN at runtime. API26–30: legacy Bluetooth plus fine location for discovery. A denied permission or unavailable radio never starts a vehicle read.
android_bluetooth.pairing: Authenticated SPP by default; connecting without saved pairing is an explicit unchecked option, never an automatic fallback.
android_bluetooth.bounds: Discovery 15 seconds, socket connect 8 seconds, native write 2 seconds, bounded RX queue; shared protocol owns command deadlines and decoding.
android_bluetooth.failure_rule: Single native owner for startup and probes; Stop/backgrounding closes pending native I/O. No automatic reconnect, fallback to M4, or vehicle-command replay. Complete observations require protocol cleanup and confirmed socket close.
android_bluetooth.simulator: Debug emulator retains an explicit development binding to the local M4 Bluetooth helper, accepting its observed MC+ BLE or EVO Classic SPP profile. Physical/release Android uses its own selected SPP socket.
android_bluetooth.qualification: Implementation/compilation and emulator native endpoint fixtures do not qualify physical permissions, discovery, VIN/diagnostic reads, disconnect or reconnect. Full original-firmware wireless/CANdi transport remains separate.
android_bluetooth.model_identification: Bluetooth names are discovery hints and MAC addresses select individual devices. The shared workflow identifies the product from VTI, validates its model-specific VTVERS firmware profile, and requires protocol 6 / 500000 readback before VIN traffic. A common SPP UUID is transport metadata, not a model identifier.
android_bluetooth.result: After a fresh completed VIN read and confirmed adapter release, show VIN, identified adapter model and observed voltage. Saved history never claims a current connection.
android_bluetooth.coverage: Model-specific host HS-CAN profiles: VIN/voltage plus Trionic 8 seven identifiers and complete current/history mask12 engine codes. EVO ECM profiles require MIC3413 V2.0.84; other EVO firmware fails before CAN setup. Physical/platform scope belongs to exact-artifact receipts. SW-CAN and original-firmware wireless transport remain unqualified.

apple_bluetooth.implementation: Native CoreBluetooth BLE shared by iPhone and macOS; native IOBluetooth Classic SPP on macOS. Rust owns adapter identification, command policy, framing, deadlines, VIN/ECM decoding and durable reports.
apple_bluetooth.profile_evidence: EVO live M4 service/characteristic discovery October 4, 2026: RX properties 48 (notify/indicate), TX properties 12 (write/writeWithoutResponse). MC-IOS profile observed in earlier M4 bench work. Use withResponse on both.
apple_bluetooth.selection: Select Bluetooth adapter; explicit discovered BLE UUID or paired Classic address. Find nearby / refresh paired adapters is explicit. No automatic connect or transport fallback.
apple_bluetooth.model_identity: Names select known candidates; shared VTI and model-specific VTVERS validation identify the product. Identical BLE UUIDs and common SPP UUID do not identify the model.
apple_bluetooth.macos: macOS 12+ ARM64 and x86_64 packages include the same connection worker and native BLE/Classic bindings. Bluetooth authorization precedes paired-device enumeration; keep the UI responsive during permission requests.
apple_bluetooth.ios: iOS 17+ ARM64 foreground BLE. Connect inside the app. Simulator loopback bindings remain Debug development effects and do not qualify physical iPhone Bluetooth.
apple_bluetooth.closure: No fresh success or completed diagnostic report before shared protocol cleanup and confirmed native transport release. Cancel, Stop and quit close the selected endpoint; late callbacks never begin another read.
apple_bluetooth.coverage: Bounded fresh VIN/voltage and HS-CAN Trionic 8 ECM information / current-history mask12 DTC reads. No clear/write/security commands, SW-CAN, or original-firmware wireless/CANdi transport.
apple_bluetooth.qualification: Exact artifact and adapter/architecture hardware receipts are separate from implementation and synthetic endpoint tests. Intel code executed under Rosetta on M4 does not qualify an Intel physical radio; iPhone compilation does not qualify phone Bluetooth.

windows_bluetooth.implementation: Windows.Devices.Bluetooth GATT and paired RFCOMM serial through thin .NET Framework bindings; the exact shared Rust 0.1.3 worker owns startup, model/firmware validation, commands, decoding and reports.
windows_bluetooth.profiles: EVO and vLinker MC-IOS BLE: service18F0/write2AF1/notify2AF0 withResponse. Paired EVO/vLinker MC or MC-Android: Serial Port UUID00001101-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb; observe its service instead of fixing a channel.
windows_bluetooth.selection: Connect and start -> Carista EVO / vLinker MC+ · Bluetooth -> select exact endpoint and transport -> Use this adapter. Discovery sends no adapter command.

session_mode_selection.workflow: Finish setup -> main screen Session Mode: Read-only / Full session -> Connect and start -> select adapter -> validate selected mode before opening transport.
rules: Show Session Mode prominently on the main screen above Connect and start after setup. Both choices are visible; USB and Bluetooth use the same selection. Do not hide the primary choice in an adapter dialog or advanced tools.

Begin a new application instance in Read-only. Full session requires an explicit foreground selection. If the selected binding cannot enforce the chosen mode, explain that limitation and open no transport; never silently substitute another mode.

Full session binds the existing full native authority where implemented, including Android Chipsoft, Nano and MX+. Unsupported bindings keep the choice visible and explain why connecting is unavailable. Bounded clearing is a separate action, not a substitute for Full session.
Show the selected mode in the normal session header and retain original firmware confirmations. Choosing a mode never replays a diagnostic action.

Changing the Ready-screen choice sends no command. Lock the control during connection, firmware changes, security processing and a running session; show the actual active mode. Stop and reconnect to change authority. Keep launch details scrollable independently of firmware controls on small screens.

Mode selection is scoped to the selected adapter and current foreground attempt. Cancel, background and stale callbacks start no connection. Internal service authentication, command policies and operation-specific consent remain.
Counter reset and security-data collection keep their separate existing workflows. No new driver or packet permission is granted by this UI.
Android security collection includes Bluetooth MX+ and uses the common collection/process/validated-import workflow with fresh vehicle identity and confirmed release. No operator password.

Full native control removes the diagnostic-service allowlist only. Standard CAN frames, supported electrical routes, authenticated role, cancellation, original confirmations and ECU authorization remain. No implicit command replay.
